title: Dennis Miller: America 180
description: Dennis Miller shares his opinion on today's America, including the current state of the nation, the failures of Obama's healthcare initiative and the antics of our top leaders.

title: Dennis Miller: Fake News, Real Jokes
description: Dennis Miller's critical assessment of the current climate, from fake news to selfies.

title: Loni Love: America's Sister
description: The comic's standup routine takes on the president, fat people, pirates, celebrities, and her love for those in America.

title: Tiffany Haddish: She Ready! From the Hood to Hollywood!
description: Rising comedy star Tiffany Haddish takes the stage in her hometown of Los Angeles to tackle subjects ranging from her early days in foster care and being bullied on the playground to getting her revenge on ex-boyfriends.

title: Andrew Schiavone: Central Nervousness
description: From growing up in Northern Virginia to feeling unsafe in his new home in New York, Andrew's charming world view shines through in stories about dating, workplace mishaps and first loves.

title: Tom Papa: Human Mule
description: Comedian Tom Papa returns to Cleveland while relating the everyman struggles of family life, falling behind to the super rich and his hilarious cure for angry young men.

title: Tom Papa: Live in New York City
description: Tom Papa discusses his life and kids; worst roommates.

title: Gina Yashere: Laughing To America
description: Gina Yashere takes the stage to perform her unapologetically hilarious stand-up routine.

title: Jay Mohr: Altamont
description: Comic Jay Mohr tackles subjects ranging from unexpected visitors to bringing up children and working with Chris Farley on "Saturday Night Live."

title: Kevin Smith: Silent But Deadly Extended Edition
description: Kevin Smith is anything but quiet in this new comedy special that was recorded an hour before his heart attack in February; before he nearly died backstage, onstage he discusses his marriage, his kid and his work (or lack thereof).

title: Margaret Cho: psyCHO
description: The comic tackles off-limits issues including Boko Haram, racism and her own sexuality.

title: Lavell Crawford: I Could Eat - Part 1
description: Lavell Crawford is back and here to contemplate how "My 600 Pound Life" could go for 15 seasons and he was still underweight, the kind of racist you have to be to not take a free holiday, and explosive consequences in a Taco Bell bathroom.

title: Jeff Dunham's 250th Red, White, And Blue Birthday Special
description: Jeff Dunham celebrates America's 250th birthday with Walter, Peanut, Bubba J and Achmed in a star-spangled comedy event full of patriotic mischief, where his crew may not understand the history, but they absolutely understand the sentiment.

title: Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood
description: Previously unseen stand-up comedy by Jeff Dunham; sketches that include popular characters; Brad Paisley performs; special appearances by comic Chris Parnell and former UFC champion Chuck Liddell.

title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
description: Jeff Dunham returns with new ventriloquist characters by starting off with the infamously known Walter, scrutinizing every bit of today's American society.

title: Tahir Moore: Aging Out
description: Tahir Moore brings high-energy, no-filter comedy in a wild ride through the zombie apocalypse, fancy toilets, naps, and aging; self-roasting, brutally honest, and always hilarious-this is stand-up with zero chill, big laughs, and all heart.

title: Bill Engvall: Here's Your Sign: It's Finally Time: My Last Show
description: Bill Engvall, renowned comedian, entertains audiences for the last time.

title: Denise Winkelman: Bougie on a Budget
description: Denise Winkelman mixes sharp wit and heartfelt humor as she shares her journey from a small town with hick parents to life as a transgender woman in Los Angeles, turning struggles into comedy.

title: Harland Williams: A Force of Nature
description: Harland Williams performs in the Mojave Desert.

title: Harland Williams: What a Treat
description: Stand-up comic Harland Williams takes center stage at the El Rey Theatre in Los Angeles for a riotous evening of laughs; featured topics range from everyman observations on fingernails and fried food to musings on dating and the Pillsbury Doughboy.

title: Josh Blue: Delete
description: In his hometown of Denver, Josh Blue discusses the daily details of his life.

title: Josh Blue: Sticky Change
description: The "Last Comic Standing"-winning comic performs.

title: Sara Huntington: Rust Belt Royalty
description: Sara Huntington shows off the stand-up skills behind her TikTok and Instagram accounts in her debut special from Columbus, Ohio.

title: Shayne Smith: Prison for Wizards
description: Comedian and former gang member, Shayne Smith performs in a stand-up special.

title: William Lee Martin: Standing in the Middle
description: The Texas comic talks about life, marriage, raising five children and living in a country that's in a constant state of flux.

title: Tom Green Live
description: In this special, Tom Green brings his comedic genius to the standup stage.

title: Michael Yo: Blasian
description: Michael Yo brings his personal blend of comedy to his debut stand up special; born and raised in Houston, Michael talks about growing up mixed in a place where he really stood out.

title: Eddie Izzard: Unrepeatable
description: Highlights of comedian Eddie Izzard's one-man show at London's Albery Theatre in March 1994 when Izzard was playing a limited seven-week run of his celebrated stand-up show.

title: Andy Sandford: &y S&ford
description: Andy Sandford dives into the absurd side of life, tackling pharmacists losing their jobs, full-sized houses on the move, and clowns on the edge. Smart, dry, and brutally funny-this is stand-up for people who notice how weird the world really is.

title: Jesus Trejo: Stay at Home Son
description: Mexican-American comic Jesus Trejo explores his upbringing as an only child to immigrant parents; he recalls learning many of life's lessons in the most unconventional ways, all the while feeling the need to meet his parents' high expectations.

title: Katrina Davis: Figuring It Out
description: Comic and writer Katrina Davis attempts to process the world around her through Southern observations, drug-related sports facts and a theory on why dying alone makes perfect sense.

title: Jimmy O. Yang: Good Deal
description: From the Neptune Theater in Seattle, the comic talks about his interactions with immigrant parents, gives his thoughts on Matt Damon and asks whether ghosts are likely to haunt one-bedroom apartments.

title: Anjelah Johnson: The Homecoming Show
description: Stand-up comedian Anjelah Johnson returns to San Jose, Calif., for a special performance.

title: Gabriel Iglesias: I'm Not Fat... I'm Fluffy
description: The comic known for wearing his signature Hawaiian shirts covers everything from his fondness for Paul Rodriguez to his own "fluffiness."

title: Gabriel Iglesias: Aloha Fluffy
description: The comic discusses his crazy world of family, friends, and world travels.

title: Jeff Dunham: Minding the Monsters
description: In the spirit of Halloween, Jeff Dunham performs with his special cast of characters including Walter, Bubba J, Peanut, Jose and Achmed all decked out in their Halloween best.

title: Jeff Dunham: I'm With Cupid
description: Ventriloquist and stand-up comedian Jeff Dunham performs an all-Valentine's Day-themed special.

title: Jeff Dunham: All Over the Map
description: Comic and ventriloquist Jeff Dunham performs across five continents, accompanied by his well-known characters, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, Peanut, Jose Jalapeño, Bubba J and Walter.

title: Tim Allen: Men Are Pigs
description: The comedian examines man's obsession with hardware at the State Theater in Kalamazoo, Mich.

title: Steve-O: Guilty as Charged
description: Steve-O goes from humble beginnings as a circus clown to finding fame on "Jackass," performing stunts and tricks.

title: Marc Maron: Thinky Pain
description: Marc Maron discusses everything from pornography to religion.

title: Susan Rice: Silver Alert
description: With decades of stand-up experience under her belt, Susan Rice takes the stage to share quips about car troubles and the joys of getting older.

title: Nicole Burch: Never Been Kissed
description: Comic Nicole Burch performs her hilarious stand-up routine.

title: Joel McHale: Live From Pyongyang
description: Joel McHale discusses feeding alligators in the south and wanting to name the San Francisco 49er's to something else.

title: Helen Hong: Well Hong
description: Standup comic Helen Hong recounts spending her COVID-19 quarantine trying to date doomsday preppers and trying to teach the world that China is not the only country in Asia.

title: Danny Martinello: Starting Sober
description: Danny Martinello's debut special dedicated to those who had his back when he decided to put down the bottle.

title: Bill Squire: Bam Bam
description: Performing in his hometown of Cleveland, comedian Bill Squire looks at his role as a parent as well as the experiences with his parents that lead to this moment.

title: Brendan Fitzgibbons: I Am the Resistance
description: Comedian Brendan Fitzgibbons makes his stand-up album debut; he digs into the wild world of single life, why dating apps now feel like rescue shelters and more.

title: Chad Daniels: As Is
description: Chad Daniels discusses everything from racist grandmothers to having a sex talk with your teen.

title: Cory Kahaney: Antique Joke Show
description: Cory Kahaney makes all the painstaking aspects of daily life ironic and uproariously funny.

title: Dom Irrera: Live From Las Vegas
description: Voted one of the hundred funniest comics of all time by Comedy Central, Dom Irrera performs his unique, uncensored comedy.

title: Jenny McCarthy's Dirty Sexy Funny
description: Female comedians Paula Bel, Tiffany Haddish, Lynne Koplitz, Justine Marino and Tammy Pescatelli join Jenny McCarthy to shed some light on what it's really like to be a woman.

title: Leanne Morgan: So Yummy
description: Leanne Morgan gives an honest look at suburban life and the challenges of keeping her husband happy while juggling kids, dogs, and cheerleading camp.

title: Jeff Dunham's 250th Red, White, And Blue Birthday Special
description: Jeff Dunham celebrates America's 250th birthday with Walter, Peanut, Bubba J and Achmed in a star-spangled comedy event full of patriotic mischief, where his crew may not understand the history, but they absolutely understand the sentiment.

description: Larry the Cable Guy is back to "Git R Done" in his latest solo special from the Rialto Square Theater in Joliet, IL.

title: Jim Gaffigan: Noble Ape
description: Comic Jim Gaffigan proves that laughter is the best medicine when he talks about a family medical crisis and other topics during his hilarious stand-up routine.

title: Jeff Dunham: All Over the Map
description: Comic and ventriloquist Jeff Dunham performs across five continents, accompanied by his well-known characters, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, Peanut, Jose Jalapeño, Bubba J and Walter.

title: Jeff Dunham: Arguing With Myself
description: The comic who has helped reintroduce the lost art of ventriloquism entertains a live audience with a little assistance from three inanimate friends who aren't nearly as wooden as their outer facades may lead you to believe.

title: Jeff Dunham: Controlled Chaos
description: A live concert performance that leans heavily on four favorite characters; cranky old man Walter, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, the mischievous purple whatsit and Peanut.

title: Tom Segura: Completely Normal
description: Comedian Tom Segura opens up about hotels, his hobbies and digestive ailments.

title: Aries Spears: Comedy Blueprint
description: Armed with his ferociously aggressive style of comedy, MAD TV alum Aries Spears takes the stage in Philadelphia for 'Comedy Blueprint.' No one - not black, not white, not gay, not straight - is safe from his jokes and impressions.

title: Billy Prinsell: Hunka Bunka's
description: Billy Prinsell's charming hilarity shines through a deep dive on dating and relationships in his debut comedy special.

title: Bob Smiley: Tartar Terrorist
description: In-demand stand-up comedian known for his machine gun approach and hilarious, clean material.

title: Butch Bradley: From Las Vegas

title: Chelle T: It Just Got Real
description: Chelle T arrives with a whirlwind of imagination, stage presence, and originality.

description: Doug Stanhope performs live in his hometown of Bisbee, Arizona.

title: Gary Gulman: Boyish Man
description: The comic performs.

title: Josh Gondelman: People Pleaser
description: Josh Gondelman performs in his debut special and the pressures of appearing in his friends' dreams.

title: Kevin Nealon: Whelmed but Not Overly
description: The comic performs in Denver; topics include the fears, insecurities and doubts of parenthood.

title: Logan Guntzelman: Boner Technology
description: Logan Guntzelman shares with an Atlanta crowd tales of her dating app standards, moving in with a boyfriend, and upgrades in male health technology.

title: Morgan Murphy: Irish Goodbye
description: Morgan Murphy performs her comedy routine.

title: Sinbad: Make Me Wanna Holla
description: Comic Sinbad discusses the life advice his family gave him; why he's tired of people with no talent having clothing lines; who he really is.

title: Sinbad: Where U Been?
description: The comic performs at the Club Nokia Theatre in Los Angeles.

title: Gabriel Iglesias: Hot and Fluffy
description: Filmed at the Fox Theater in Bakersfield, California the comedian and well-known favorite to television viewers as being on "Last Comic Standing," performs impressions and silly voices.
